What We Do

Branding + Traffic + Sales: the ecosystem that separates brands from posts

Makewell doesn't deliver isolated services. Each of the six areas below exists to feed the others, because content without traffic is invisible, traffic without CRM is waste and brand without method is luck.

Why integration matters

When you hire a traditional agency, each service becomes a silo: the branding agency doesn't talk to the media agency, which doesn't talk to the sales team. Result: you pay three suppliers to produce three strategies that don't communicate. At Makewell, everything happens under one roof, with one team and a single strategy.

Positioning
Content
Traffic
Sales + CRM

Our 6 integrated services

You can hire one, some or all, but the real power appears when they operate together.

01

Branding + Positioning

We build brands that mean something — not just nice logos. The foundation for everything that comes after.

What it isVisual identity + verbal architecture + strategic market positioning.
Who it servesIndependent professionals and companies in repositioning or launch phases.
We deliverBrand manual, visual system, tone of voice, differentiation narrative.
Expected resultClarity of market perception and solid foundation for performance campaigns.
02

Social + Content

Magnetic content that educates, positions and pulls the right client — not the biggest follower count.

What it isEditorial planning, audiovisual production, copywriting and social selling.
Who it servesClients who already have a brand and need consistent presence on Instagram, LinkedIn or YouTube.
We deliverEditorial line, monthly calendar, carousels, short videos, Reels scripts.
Expected resultQualified audience and organic growth with real purchase intent.
03

Paid Traffic

Meta Ads, Google Ads and LinkedIn Ads operated by people who can read P&L, not just platform dashboards.

What it isPaid media management focused on conversion, not reach.
Who it servesBusinesses that need to accelerate qualified lead generation and predictability.
We deliverFunnel strategy, creatives, targeting, continuous optimization, monthly reports.
Expected resultDecreasing cost per lead and ROI measured in real currency — not impressions.
04

Sales + CRM

We implement a real sales process: SPIN methodology, integrated CRM and SDR where it makes sense.

What it isSales consulting + CRM implementation + commercial team training.
Who it servesCompanies that receive leads but lose money at closing for lack of process.
We deliverSales playbook, configured CRM, scripts, conversion dashboard, training.
Expected resultHigher conversion rate and predictability over the sales cycle.
05

SEO + Website

Websites that rank on Google and convert — not just "look good".

What it isWeb development + technical SEO + conversion landing pages.
Who it servesBrands that depend on organic search or need capture pages.
We deliverFast websites, landing pages, on-page SEO, Schema.org, Search Console monitoring.
Expected resultQualified organic traffic and pages that convert visits into leads.
06

Automation + AI

Bots, flows and integrations that qualify leads 24/7, saving sales team time.

What it isMarketing automation (email, WhatsApp, ManyChat) and AI application in the funnel.
Who it servesBusinesses with high lead volume and need for automatic screening.
We deliverAutomated flows, chatbots, CRM + WhatsApp + email integrations.
Expected resultLead arrives ready to close. Salesperson doesn't waste time with repeated questions.

How we start together

Our services are structured — the diagnostic exists to point out which one resolves your moment. When the need is specific, we build a custom scope.

01

Strategic diagnostic

Initial meeting to understand the business, marketing history, revenue objectives and current gaps. No cost, no commitment.

02

Customized proposal

Based on the diagnostic, we indicate the service that resolves your moment — or design a specific scope if the need is different. Timeline and investment always clear.

03

Onboarding and execution

Kickoff with dedicated team, schedule, recurring meetings and tracking dashboard. Real deliverables from month one.

Want to understand the framework behind the execution?

All services operate within a single structured framework — and each client goes through a defined journey.
